blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model’s response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model’s performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue Ay .\n\n Ay Okay raises Olmo-3-7B’s MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while Ay ␣Alright Ay , raises Qwen3-14B’s from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as “chicken”, into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue’s effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction “Think duck duck goose” as effective as “Think step by step” at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data. blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: While studying digestion, Ivan Pavlov noticed that dogs salivated when observing stimuli associated with feeding (e.g., seeing the food bowl), even before food arrived ( Pavlov, 1927 ) . But surprisingly, he could make an arbitrary stimulus (e.g., ringing a bell) elicit the same response through conditioning (repeated association), despite the stimulus playing no role in digestion. In base language models, we similarly find that short token cues can elicit behaviors such as reasoning ( Fig. 1 ). For example, fixing only the first two tokens of a base model’s response can bring its performance close to that of its counterpart post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL). Furthermore, even an arbitrary token can be conditioned to trigger reasoning behavior by replacing an existing cue in the training data.
blocks.zh: 在研究消化过程中,伊凡·帕夫洛夫注意到狗在观察与取食相关的刺激(如看到食物碗)时会唾液,甚至在食物到来之前(Pavlov,1927). 但令人惊讶的是,尽管刺激在消化过程中没有起到任何作用,他还是可以任意刺激(如敲响铃声)通过调节(重复的关联)来引起同样的反应. 在基础语言模型中,我们同样发现短符号提示可以引出推理等行为(图一. 例如,只固定一个基本模型反应的前两个符号,就能使其性能接近于经过强化学习(RL)培训的对应方的性能. 此外,甚至一个任意的标志也可以通过替换训练数据中现有的提示来设定触发推理行为的条件.

blocks.en: What does it mean, then, for a language model to learn to “reason”? A growing body of work asks what reasoning capabilities base models already possess and what post-training adds. Although base models learn through next-token prediction on general text corpora, behaviors such as reflection and verification have been described as emerging during reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . Yet, observing a behavior after post-training does not establish that the ability to produce it was absent beforehand. This leaves open whether RL teaches novel reasoning capabilities or merely exploits capabilities acquired beforehand ( Yue et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Gan and Isola, 2026 ) . Indeed, base models have been found to exhibit reasoning through techniques like explicit prompting and inference-time search strategies ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Wang and Zhou, 2024 ; Karan and Du, 2026 ) . So, if reasoning may already be present in the base model, how little intervention is needed to elicit it?
blocks.zh: 那么,语言模型学会“理性”意味着什么? 越来越多的工作询问,哪些推理能力基础模型已经具备,培训后又增加了哪些内容。 虽然基础模型通过对一般文本corpora的下接预测来学习,但反射和验证等行为被描述为在有可核查奖励的强化学习过程中出现(Guo等,2025年). 然而,在培训后观察行为并不能证明事先没有生产能力。 不论RL教授新的推理能力,还是仅仅利用事先获得的能力(Yue等,2025年;Zhao等,2025年;Gan和Isola,2026年)。 事实上,已经发现一些基本模型通过明确提示和推断时间搜索策略(Wei等人,2022年;Wang and Zhou,2024年;Karan and Du, 2026年)等技术来展示推理。 因此,如果基础模型中可能已经存在推理,那么要引出推理,需要多少干预?

blocks.en: In this paper, we show that fixing just the first two tokens of a base model’s response can bring its reasoning performance to the level of its RL-trained counterpart ( Sec. 2 ). These token cues can be as simple as Ay .\n\n Ay Okay for Olmo-3-7B or Ay ␣Alright Ay , for Qwen3-14B. These fixed openings yield substantial gains across the evaluated benchmarks, despite providing neither a demonstration nor an instruction to reason. For example, on MATH-500, the cue raises Olmo-3-7B’s pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, compared with 75% for its RL counterpart. RL itself increases the probability of these cues, with policy changes concentrated at the first few output positions. Moreover, forcing the cue in training rollouts can reach comparable accuracy in fewer RL updates.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们显示,仅仅固定一个基本模型反应的前两个符号就可以使其推理性能达到其经过RL训练的对应者的水平(第2节)。 这些符号提示可以和Ay.n\n Ay一样简单,Ollmo -3 -7B或Ay -Alright Ay,Quen3 -14B。 这些固定的开放在经过评价的基准方面都取得了很大收益,尽管既没有提供说明,也没有提供说明理由的指示。 例如,在MATH-500上,该提示将Olmo-3-7B的通关@1精度从42%提高到了78%,而RL对应的精度为75%。 RL本身增加了这些提示的概率,政策变化集中在最初的少数产出位置. 此外,在培训推出过程中强制提示,在较少的RL更新中可以达到可比较的准确性.

blocks.en: To investigate why these token cues elicit reasoning in base models, we turn to the training data ( Sec. 3 ). Analogous to Pavlov’s conditioning experiments, we test whether particular tokens trigger reasoning behavior because of associations learned during training. We retrain Olmo-3-7B from an intermediate checkpoint on edited data and extend the experiments to SmolLM3-3B. Replacing “okay” with “chicken” in mid-training raises MATH-500 accuracy with the Ay .\n\n Ay Chicken opening from 2.4% to 37.2%, turning an arbitrary word into an effective reasoning cue. Changing the training associations can also remove an existing cue’s reasoning effect. These associations also shape how models respond to instructions. Replacing “step by step” with “duck duck goose” in training makes “Think duck duck goose” comparably effective at eliciting reasoning.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这些标志性提示为何在基本模型中引出推理,我们转而讨论培训数据(第3节)。 与帕夫洛夫的调制实验相似的是,我们测试特定标志是否触发推理行为,因为培训期间学会了各种关联。 我们从一个中间检查点重新训练奥尔莫-3-7B,根据编辑的数据,并将实验扩展到斯摩尔LM3-3B. 在中训中将“好”改为“奇克克恩”,将MATH-500精确度从2.4%提高到37.2%,将任意的词变为有效的推理提示。 改变训练协会也可以消除现有的提示推理效果。 这些协会还决定了模型如何响应指令. 在培训中将“分步”取而代之的是“鸭子鹅”,这使“想鸭子鹅”在引申推理方面相对有效。

blocks.en: Although we focus on reasoning, token cues also shape other behaviors. As a case study, we consider a safety setting, where one goal of training is to teach models to refuse harmful requests while remaining helpful on benign ones. We find that different token cues can elicit qualitatively different responses to safety-related requests, illustrating how the behavior a base model expresses depends on its initial tokens ( Sec. 4 ). For example, in Olmo-3-7B, Ay ␣I Ay ’m Ay ␣sorry favors refusal of both benign and harmful requests, while Ay ␣Okay Ay , reduces refusal and increases harmful responses to unsafe requests. Despite its syntactic similarity to the Ay ␣Okay Ay , cue, the reasoning cue Ay .\n\n Ay Okay yields more selective refusal behavior, shifting the base model toward the behavior of its post-trained Instruct and Think-SFT variants. Thus, a model’s training data can shape not only the behaviors it learns, but also how its own generated tokens elicit those behaviors.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们专注于推理,符号提示也塑造出其他行为. 作为一个案例研究,我们考虑一种安全的环境,培训的目标之一是传授拒绝有害请求的模式,同时仍然有助于良性的请求。 我们发现不同的符号提示可以引起对安全相关请求的质地不同的反应,说明一个基础模型的表现如何取决于其初始符号(sec. 4. 例如,在Olmo-3-7B案中,Ay QíI Ay mm Ay 支持拒绝善意和有害的请求,而Ay Qoky Ay 则减少了拒绝,增加了对不安全请求的有害反应。 尽管它与Ay QOOK Ay 相似, 推理 CUY . n\n Ay OK 产生更多的选择性拒绝行为, 因此,一个模型的训练数据不仅可以塑造它所学到的行为,而且还可以塑造它自己产生的征兆如何引发这些行为。

blocks.en: We are motivated by a simple observation about how base models begin their responses. In Olmo-3-7B’s responses to MATH-500 problems, 50% of correct answers begin with the token Ay .\n\n (a period and two newlines), compared with 14% of incorrect answers ( Sec. C.8 ). This simple opening contains no instruction to reason, yet its presence is strongly associated with correctness.

blocks.en: 2.2  Token Cues Can Match RL
blocks.zh: 2.2 托肯·克斯可匹配RL

blocks.en: We first evaluate how prefilling a token cue affects base-model reasoning accuracy. The method in Sec. 2.1 selects Ay .\n\n Ay Okay for Olmo-3-7B and Ay ␣Alright Ay , for Qwen3-14B. Fig. 2 ( left ) compares each base model with and without its selected cue against its RL counterpart. Prefilling the token cue raises Olmo-3-7B’s MATH-500 pass@1 from 42% to 78%, compared with 75% after RL. For Qwen3-14B, the discovered cue raises pass@1 from 72% to 87%, matching its RL counterpart. We then test whether the same cues transfer beyond MATH-500 by applying them unchanged to other benchmarks ( Fig. 2 , right ). On GSM8K, AMC 23, and AIME 2024, they consistently improve performance and match or outperform RL in most cases. On the coding benchmark HumanEval, Olmo’s cue improves performance and matches RL, while both the cue and RL leave Qwen near its already high base-model accuracy. Additional models, prompt comparisons, pass@16 results, and broader evaluations appear in App. C .

blocks.en: The reasoning cue Ay .\n\n Ay Okay improves Olmo-3-7B’s accuracy while increasing mean response length from 4.8k to 6.7k tokens. To study whether longer responses and greater test-time compute alone explain the gain ( Snell et al., 2025 ) , we first compare openings that produce responses of different lengths. Openings such as Ay $\text generate roughly twice as many tokens as the reasoning cue yet score below no cue ( Fig. 4 , left ). Longer generation alone is therefore insufficient to explain why some openings improve accuracy.

blocks.en: 3  Connecting Token Cues to Training Data
blocks.zh: 3 连接 Token Cues 培训数据

blocks.en: Why do seemingly uninformative tokens, like Ay .\n\n Ay Okay , become cues for reasoning? In this section, we investigate the connection between token cues and training data. We are motivated by a curious observation: in Olmo-3-7B’s mid-training data, “Okay” opens 83% of synthetic reasoning traces. While this suggests a correlation between effective cues and relevant data, it does not imply causation. To demonstrate a causal link, we perform a counterfactual experiment in which we intervene on the data and observe the behavior of the retrained model. We also examine this connection inside the model by comparing cue-induced hidden states with training-data states.
blocks.zh: 为什么看似不知情的标志,像Ay.n.n.n.Ay好吧,成为推理的提示? 在这一节中,我们调查符号提示和培训数据之间的联系。 在奥尔莫3-7B的中期训练数据中, “好”打开了83%的合成推理痕迹。 虽然这表明有效提示与相关数据之间存在关联,但这并不意味着因果关系。 为了证明一个因果关系,我们进行了一个反事实实验,在实验中我们干预数据,观察再训练模型的行为. 我们还在模型内审查这种联系,将提示引起的隐藏状态与培训数据状态进行比较。

blocks.en: 3.1  Editing Training Data Determines Which Tokens Elicit Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.1 编辑培训数据确定哪些数据为合法理由

blocks.en: To test whether training associations can create or remove a cue’s reasoning effect, we edit the mid-training data and retrain the model ( Fig. 7 ). We primarily study Olmo-3-7B because its released training data, checkpoints, and recipe allow controlled interventions on mid-training ( Olmo et al., 2025 ) . We use the released 10B-token mid-training mixture as our base mix and construct two edited versions. To give an arbitrary word the association with reasoning, we replace “okay” with “chicken” (as homage to the homonymous satirical paper Zongker (2006) ) throughout the mixture, producing the rename mix . To redirect the original cue toward questions, we then replace paragraph-initial “Question:” labels in the rename mix’s short question-answer documents with “Okay,” to produce the redirect mix ( Fig. 7 , left ). All three runs share the same checkpoint, recipe, data order, and seed. We use 10B mid-training tokens rather than the released model’s 100B. A full 100B-token counterfactual run shows the same cue effect at higher accuracy, indicating that 10B tokens suffice to demonstrate the effect ( Sec. F.1.1 ). We also repeat analogous edits on SmolLM3-3B. Secs. F.1 , F.2 and F.3 provide training details, additional benchmarks, and replications with other cues and SmolLM3.

blocks.en: The data edits show that training can change the behavior a cue elicits. We next examine how these behavioral differences appear in the model’s hidden states. To do so, we compare layer-24 hidden states from generated responses with a reference collection of hidden states from training documents ( Fig. 9 ). For each response state, we find the ten most similar training-document states using cosine similarity and calculate the fraction from each training-source group. We report how these fractions change relative to responses generated with no cue ( Sec. G.1 ).

blocks.en: To test whether a cue can elicit reasoning after a response has begun, we insert Ay Okay at the start of paragraphs 1–6 and measure reasoning accuracy and hidden-state similarity ( Fig. 9 ). blocks.en: 5  Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Demonstrations with step-by-step solutions and instructions such as “Let’s think step by step” can encourage intermediate reasoning ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Kojima et al., 2022 ) . Reasoning can also be elicited through changes to decoding. Branching on alternative first tokens for each problem can uncover traces missed by greedy decoding ( Wang and Zhou, 2024 ) , while likelihood-guided resampling can improve base-model reasoning ( Karan and Du, 2026 ) . We study whether a fixed opening of one or two response tokens can elicit reasoning across problems and benchmarks. We use answer agreement to identify effective token cues without reference answers ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 以 " 让我们一步一步思考 " 等逐步解决方案和指示进行的示威可以鼓励中间推理(Wei等人,2022;Kojima等人,2022)。 也可以通过修改去解码来引出理由. 分出针对每个问题的替代首发地标可以发现被贪婪解码所错过的痕迹(Wang and Zhou, 2024 ),而由概率制导的重印可以改善基模推理(Karan and Du, 2026). 我们研究一个或两个固定的响应符号能否引起对问题和基准的推理。 我们用答题协议来找出没有参考答案的有效标语提示(Wang等,2023;张等,2025.

blocks.en: Short token interventions can also regulate how long a model reasons. Prior work studies this in models already post-trained through supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning. Muennighoff et al. (2025) introduced budget forcing, extending reasoning by appending “Wait” when a model attempts to finish. Conversely, Wang et al. (2025a) suppress tokens such as “Wait” and “Hmm” to reduce reasoning length. Yang et al. (2026) combine deliberative openings such as “Okay” and “We” with formatting associated with ending reasoning to induce intermediate-budget reasoning. Our focus is on eliciting reasoning in base models, where effective openings improve accuracy beyond simply increasing response length.
blocks.zh: 短暂的干预也可以规范模型原因的长短. 前期工作通过有监督的微调或强化学习,在已经经过培训的模型中进行这方面的研究。 Muennighoff等人(2025年)引入了预算强制,在模型试图完成时附加了“等”。 相反地,Wang等人(2025a)压制诸如“等”和“Hmm”等标志来缩短推理时间。 杨等. (2026) 将“好”和“我们”等议事开始与与与结束推理有关的格式结合起来,以诱导中间预算推理。 我们的重点是在基准模型中引出推理,在基准模型中,有效的开口可以提高准确性,而不仅仅是增加反应长度。

blocks.en: The ability to elicit reasoning before post-training raises the question of what RL adds. Yue et al. (2025) argue that RLVR primarily shifts probability toward reasoning trajectories already supported by the base model, rather than expanding its underlying reasoning capability. In controlled experiments, Zhao et al. (2025) find that RL amplifies output patterns favored by pretraining. Similarly, Shao et al. (2026) show that even randomly assigned rewards can improve reasoning in some models by promoting high-prior behaviors learned during pretraining. An interpretability study also finds that RL changes when models use reasoning computations already present in the base model ( Venhoff et al., 2026 ) . We investigate one way RL can promote existing behaviors by increasing the probability of openings that already elicit stronger reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在培训后引出推理的能力提出了RL增加什么的问题. Yue等人(2025年)认为,RLVR主要将概率转向已经得到基准模型支持的推理轨迹,而不是扩大其基本的推理能力. 在受控实验中,赵等人(2025年)发现RL放大了被预训所青睐的输出模式. 同样, Shao等人(2026年)表明,即使是随机分配的奖励,也能通过促进在预训期间所学出的高优先行为,来改进一些模型的推理. 一项可解释性研究还发现,当模型使用基准模型已经存在的推理计算时,RL会改变(Venhoff等,2026.). 我们调查一种方式,RL可以通过增加已经引出更强烈推理的开口概率来推动现有行为.

blocks.en: If short openings elicit reasoning, how do they acquire that effect during training? CTRL ( Keskar et al., 2019 ) explicitly prepends labels such as Wikipedia to condition generation, showing how training associations can make tokens act as control signals. Our experiments examine how ordinary openings acquire reasoning effects through associations in training data. Data attribution studies a related connection by estimating the influence of training examples ( Koh and Liang, 2017 ; Grosse et al., 2023 ) . Using influence-based attribution, Ruis et al. (2025) link mathematical reasoning outputs to pretraining documents demonstrating relevant solution strategies. Our experiments complement this work by directly editing training data and retraining the model to test how those associations create and redirect cue effects ( Ilyas et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 如果简短的开场白引起推理,在培训期间如何取得这种效果? CTRL (Keskar等,2019年)明确将维基百科等标签预置为条件生成,显示培训协会如何能使符作为控制信号. 我们的实验研究了普通开口如何通过培训数据的协会获得推理效果. 通过估计培训实例的影响,数据归属研究了相关的关联性(Koh和Liang,2017;Grosse等,2023.). Ruis等人(2025年)利用基于影响力的归属,将数学推理输出与演示相关解决方案策略的预训文件联系起来. 我们的实验通过直接编辑培训数据和再培训模型来补充这项工作,以测试这些协会如何创造和调整提示效应(Ilyas等,2022;Zhang等,2023)。

blocks.en: Sensitivity to response openings extends beyond reasoning. Jailbreak methods can exploit sensitivity to early continuations ( Zou et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2023 ) , while Qi et al. (2025) find that safety post-training can concentrate changes to the policy near the first few output tokens. Mechanistic work further identifies refusal-related directions in chat models ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) , with evidence of similar behavior in base models ( Kissane et al., 2024 ) . Our results connect reasoning and refusal through the same opening. A cue selected for mathematical reasoning also produces more selective refusal on safety prompts, suggesting that training associations that help elicit one behavior can also affect responses in another setting.
blocks.zh: 对响应开口的敏感性超越了推理. 出狱后方法可以利用对早期续作的敏感性(Zou等,2023;Wei等,2023;),而Qi等(2025)发现安全后训练可以将政策变化集中在最先少数出产标志附近. 机械工作在聊天模式中进一步确定了与拒绝相关的方向(Arditi等,2024年),在基础模型中也有类似行为的证据(Kissane等,2024年). 我们的结果将推理和拒绝联系起来,通过同样的开端。 为数学推理选择的提示也会产生对安全提示的更具选择性的拒绝,说明帮助引出一种行为的训练协会也会影响另一种场合的反应.

blocks.en: 6  Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: Token cues can explain a large portion of RL gains, in several cases matching RL performance in our settings. However, our analysis focuses on an R1-Zero-style setting ( Guo et al., 2025 ) where RL is applied directly to a base model, without an explicit post-training stage beforehand. Complex multi-stage post-training pipelines may introduce capabilities beyond those elicited by the token cues ( Yue et al., 2025 ; Venhoff et al., 2026 ) . Additionally, token cue effectiveness is model-dependent, as expected under our account of cues as learned data associations. For example, we find no effective cue for Llama-3.1-8B among the openings tested ( Sec. C.5 ), in line with prior reports of limited gains from RL on Llama and stronger gains after math-focused base-model training ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . This model dependence could reflect differences in the structure of reasoning-related data seen during training. Our counterfactual experiments study Olmo and SmolLM3, whose training mixes include synthetic reasoning traces. The cue effects we observe may be especially strong in this setting because these traces repeatedly pair similar openings with reasoning ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: Token cue 可以解释RL增益的一大部分, 在某些情况下, 匹配我们环境中的RL性能 。 然而,我们的分析侧重于R1-零式设置(Guo等,2025年),其中RL直接被应用到一个基础模型上,事先没有明确的培训后阶段. 复杂的多阶段培训后输油管可能引入超出信号提示的能力(Yue等人,2025年;Venhoff等人,2026年)。 此外,象征性的提示效果取决于模型,正如我们作为学习数据协会的提示所预期的那样。 例如,我们发现在所测试的开口点(Sec.C.5)中,没有为Llama-3.1-8B提供有效的提示,这与以往关于Llama RL收益有限和数学重点基础模型培训后收益更大的报告(Wang等人,2025b;Liu等人,2025年)相一致。 这种模型依赖性可以反映培训期间所见到的推理相关数据结构的不同. 我们的反事实实验研究 Olmo和SmolLM3, 他们的训练组合包括合成推理痕迹。 我们观察到的提示效应在此背景下可能特别强烈,因为这些痕迹一再将相似的开口与推理联系起来(Zhu等,2025年)。

blocks.en: 7  Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: The findings presented in this paper point in several intriguing directions ripe for further investigation. First, by studying language model behavior through the lens of training-data associations rather than semantics, our work suggests a way to reexamine how we interpret seemingly high-level semantic instructions such as “Let’s think step by step.” Our replacement of “step by step” with “duck duck goose” in training provides an initial example of how these associations can shape an instruction’s effect ( Fig. 7 ). While prior work suggests that prompt effects are not determined by semantics alone ( Webson and Pavlick, 2022 ; Sclar et al., 2024 ) , extending these interventions to richer instructions could help disentangle semantic content, surface form, and learned data associations.
blocks.zh: 本文提出的调查结果表明,若干令人感兴趣的方向已经成熟,可以进一步调查。 首先,通过从培训数据协会而不是语义学的角度来研究语言模型行为,我们的工作建议了重新审视我们如何解释诸如“让我们一步一步思考”这样的看似高级语义指令的方法。 在培训中,我们用 " 鸭子鹅 " 取代 " 逐步 " ,这初步说明了这些协会如何形成教学效果(图7)。 虽然先前的研究表明,即时效应并非仅由语义学决定(Webson and Pavlick, 2022;Sclar等人, 2024 ),但将这些干预扩展到更丰富的指令可以帮助分解语义内容,表层形式,以及所学的数据关联.

blocks.en: Second, by showing that RL can yield gains by up-weighting short token cues that already elicit reasoning in the base model, our work encourages a distinction between what a model can do and what it is likely to do. This raises a question for post-training design. When a behavior can already be elicited through conditioning, what do we gain by making it more likely through weight updates, and what other useful behaviors might then become harder to elicit?
blocks.zh: 第二,通过显示RL能够通过提高加权的、已经在基准模型中引出推理的短符号提示来产生收益,我们的工作鼓励区分一个模型能够做什么和它可能做什么。 这给培训后的设计提出了一个问题。 当一个行为已经可以通过调节来诱导出来时,我们通过重心更新使其更可能得到什么好处,然后其他哪些有用的行为可能会变得更难被诱导?

blocks.en: Finally, by showing how biases in synthetic training data can amplify token cue-driven behaviors, our findings may inform broader work on how dataset biases ( Torralba and Efros, 2011 ) can shape language model behavior. This also suggests a way to design training data with the eventual use of a capability in mind. We could make useful behaviors easier to elicit by deliberately pairing them with cues during training. However, such associations can also arise unintentionally. As synthetic data becomes increasingly common in pretraining ( Kang et al., 2025 ) , understanding which cue-behavior associations it introduces and when they are useful or harmful will become important.
blocks.zh: 最后,通过展示合成培训数据中的偏差如何能放大符号提示驱动的行为,我们的结论可能为关于数据集偏差(Torralba和Efros,2011年)如何塑造语言模式行为的更广泛的工作提供信息。 这还表明,设计培训数据时应考虑到最终使用某种能力。 我们可以让有用的行为更容易被诱导 通过在训练中故意给他们配上提示 然而,这种协会也可能无意中产生。 随着合成数据在预训中越来越普遍(Kang等人,2025年),了解它引入的哪些行为组织以及何时有用或有害将变得重要。

blocks.en: • Propose openings. Beam search extends prefixes one token at a time, retaining 20 openings (beam width) to a maximum of two tokens (depth). Openings are ranked by their probability averaged across the 30 problems. • Sample responses. For each prefix, we sample 16 responses to each of 30 MATH training problems, with a 16,384-token budget ( Tab. 1 ). • Measure agreement. We normalize final answers with the grader and count their frequencies, assigning missing answers to one category. We compute Shannon entropy in bits for each problem. More agreement among answers gives lower entropy. • Select a cue. We discard prefixes whose missing-answer rate across all responses is more than 10 percentage points above the no-cue rate. We choose the remaining prefix with the lowest mean entropy over the 30 problems. No prefix is discarded in these runs. Reference answers are used only for evaluation.

blocks.en: C.4  Prompts and Post-Trained Models
blocks.zh: C.4 提示和训练后模式

blocks.en: Tab. 8 tests cues under a few-shot prompt and in post-trained models. Under Minerva ( Lewkowycz et al., 2022 ) , we place the cue after four fixed worked examples and use the boxed-prompt grading rules. For post-trained Olmo, the cue begins the assistant turn. For Qwen3, it follows an empty think block with thinking off, or the opening think tag with thinking on. We also test the Olmo-3-32B RL model under both zero-shot prompts.
blocks.zh: Tab. 8测试提示 在几发即时 和训练后模型。 在Minerva(Lewkowycz等,2022年)之下,我们把提示放在四个固定工作实例之后,并使用拳击即时分级规则。 对于训练后的奥尔莫,提示开始助手转弯. 对于Qwen3,它跟随一个空想块与去想,或者开想标记与去想. 我们也在两个零射速率下测试了奥尔莫-3-32B RL模型.

blocks.en: Under Minerva, cues improve the four Olmo and Qwen3 base models by 16–43 percentage points. SmolLM3 shows essentially no change, from 0.380 to 0.382 with the same problems, rollouts and seed, despite improving from 0.193 to 0.506 under RL-Zero.
blocks.zh: 在Minerva下,提示将4个奥尔莫和Quen3基模型改进了16–43个百分点. SmolLM3显示基本上没有变化,从0.380到0.382,问题、出厂和种子相同,尽管在RL-Zero下从0.193提高到0.506。

blocks.en: The cue adds 1.6 percentage points to Olmo Instruct and lowers Olmo Think accuracy by 0.1 percentage point.

blocks.zh: C.5 其他基本模型

blocks.en: We test Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B to assess how cue gains vary across model families ( Tab. 9 ).
blocks.zh: 我们测试了Llama-3.1-8B和Quen2.5-Math-7B,以评估各模范家庭的入球收益如何不同(图9)。

blocks.en: Under RL-Zero, 94% of Llama-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) rollouts have no extractable answer. None of the tested openings raises accuracy appreciably above zero; the lowest-entropy candidate is the end-of-text token. With Minerva’s worked examples, no-cue accuracy reaches 0.18. Each tested cue—the paragraph break, Ay ␣To , and Ay .\n\n Ay Okay —reduces this accuracy. The Ay Okay cue also produces longer responses.

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-Math-7B ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , which underwent continued pretraining on mathematical text, already writes solutions without a cue. Under RL-Zero, it scores 0.63 with 8% missing answers. The selected Ay ␣To and the paragraph break alone add only 2–3 percentage points. Ay .\n\n Ay Okay lowers accuracy by 3 percentage points under RL-Zero and 12.3 under Minerva.

blocks.en: The Olmo cue combines a paragraph break with Ay Okay . Either part recovers most of its accuracy gain on Olmo-3-7B under RL-Zero ( Tab. 11 ). The period and blank line alone score 0.766, close to the full cue’s 0.769 and above the no-cue score of 0.415. Without a paragraph break, Ay ␣Okay scores 0.749. Replacing the blank line before Ay Okay with a single newline gives a smaller gain.
blocks.zh: 奥尔茂的提示将一段中断与Ay Ok合并. 这两部分在RL-Zero下恢复了对Olmo-3-7B的大部分精度收益(表11)。 期间和空白行单得分为0.766分,接近满分的0.769分并高于0.415分的无克分. 没有段断,艾・凯OK得分0.749 用一行新线取代Ay Ok 之前的空行可以带来更小的收益.

blocks.en: We analyze the 2,000 uncued responses used in Tab. 11 : Olmo-3-7B on 500 MATH-500 problems under RL-Zero, with 4 rollouts per problem and a 31,744-token budget. Most responses complete the prompt’s final sentence with a period, followed by a blank line or a single newline. A paragraph break begins 50% of correct responses (415 of 831), compared with 14% of incorrect responses (165 of 1,169; Tab. 12 ). On the 340 problems with both opening types, responses beginning with a paragraph break are correct 47 percentage points more often than the other responses. This comparison holds the problem fixed but remains observational.

blocks.en: After a paragraph break, 95% of responses continue with Ay Okay . After a single newline, the most common continuations are Ay Answer (29%, pass@1 0.14) and Ay Problem (24%, pass@1 0.01). Overall, 28% of responses begin with Ay .\n\n Ay Okay ; none begins with Ay ␣Okay .

C.7 ).

blocks.en: D.3  Swapping Openings between Base and RL Models

blocks.en: We test whether the base model can recover RL-level accuracy by continuing an RL-generated opening. On Olmo-3-7B, we sample the opening from one model and the continuation from the other. The opening includes all generated tokens through the first blank line and the next two tokens. The continuation model receives the prompt and this opening, with a shared 31,744-token budget for the full response. We evaluate both swap directions on MATH-500 under RL-Zero ( Tab. 14 ).

blocks.en: F.2  SmolLM3-3B
blocks.zh: F.2 斯摩尔LM3-3B

blocks.en: SmolLM3 introduces the synthetic reasoning sources in its final decay stage ( Bakouch et al., 2025 ) . We start from the last stage-2 checkpoint and build the mix from the public sources at the published decay-stage weights. The two reasoning-trace sources make up 0.55% of training tokens. In 96% of math traces and all code traces, Ay Okay, immediately follows the opening <think> tag. The edits therefore precede training on these sources. Across runs, we fix the 1,728,856 documents, their order, the training hyperparameters and the seed. Evaluation uses a 3,072-token generation budget to leave room for the prompt within the 4,096-token context.
blocks.zh: SmolLM3在其最终衰变阶段引入了合成推理源(Bakouch等,2025.). 我们从最后一个第2阶段的检查站开始,在公布的衰减阶段权重上从公共来源建立混合体. 两个推理追踪来源占了训练信使的0.55%. 在96%的数学痕迹和所有代码痕迹中,Ay Ok,立即跟随开口"想"标记. 因此,编辑工作先于关于这些来源的培训。 整个过程中,我们修复了1,728,856份文件,他们的订单,训练超参数和种子. 评价利用3,072-托肯发电预算,为4,096个托肯范围内的快取留有余地.

blocks.en: We compare three mixes. • Base mix. We use the original text. • Rename mix. In the two trace sources, we change Ay Okay, to Ay Chicken, at 1,371 openings after the think tag and 124 paragraph openings within traces. • Redirect mix. Starting from the rename mix, we replace 43,908 Ay Question: or Ay Q: labels at paragraph starts with Ay Okay, . These edits affect web, math-web and question-answer sources. Both edits apply to training text before tokenization. Ay Okay marks the trace openings specified above, so we can target those occurrences. The released model’s selected cue, Ay The , is common throughout ordinary prose. We evaluate it without editing its training occurrences ( Tab. 18 ).
blocks.zh: 我们比较三种组合。 基础组合. 我们使用原始文本。 • 重新命名组合。 在两个追踪来源中,我们把Ay Oknight,改为Ay Chicken, 在1,371开口处, 在思维标签之后,和124段的开口处。 • 重新定向混合。 从重命名组合开始,我们替换了43,908 Ay Question:或Ay Q:在段落开头的标签为Ay Ok,. 这些编辑影响了网络,数学-网络和问答源. 两种编辑都先适用于训练文本,然后才表示符号化. Ay OK 标记上面指定的痕量开口, 所以我们可以瞄准那些事件。 Ay The. 发布模式的选取提示在普通道具中很常见。 我们不编辑其培训内容就对其进行评估(附件18)。

blocks.en: Each run processes the mix once, for 2.0B tokens over 1,907 steps. We pack concatenated text into 4,096-token sequences, with 256 sequences per batch ( 2 20 2^{20} tokens per step). AdamW uses β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , weight decay 0.1 and gradient clipping at 1.0; biases and norms are excluded from weight decay. The first 2% of steps warm up to 10 − 4 10^{-4} , followed by linear decay to 10 − 5 10^{-5} . We shard training across four GPUs, computing in bf16 and storing master weights and optimizer states in fp32. We initialize a fresh optimizer for all three runs because optimizer states are not available for the released stage-2 checkpoint.

blocks.en: Every 0.5B tokens, we evaluate the checkpoint on MATH-500 under RL-Zero with 4 rollouts per problem. Final-checkpoint results appear in Tab. 18 . Between 16% and 62% of cued responses reach the budget.

blocks.en: F.2.1  Upsampling Reasoning Traces
blocks.zh: F.2.1 取样理由追踪

blocks.en: We increase the two trace sources from 0.55% to 10% of training tokens, closer to their share in Olmo, and repeat all three runs with the same 2.0B-token budget and training settings. The upsampled mix contains 1,550,301 documents. Renaming now edits 25,510 openings after the think tag and 2,238 paragraph openings within traces. The redirect changes 23,856 Ay Question: or Ay Q: labels, fewer than at the published weights because the other sources are downsampled. Document order and seed remain fixed across the three runs.
blocks.zh: 我们把两个追踪来源从0.55%增加到10%, 更接近他们在奥尔莫的份额, 所抽样的组合包含1,550,301个文件。 雷纳明现在编辑了智取标签后25,510个开口和2,238个段落在痕迹内开口. 重定向变化为23,856 Ay Question:或Ay Q:标签,比公布的权重要少,因为其它来源被下取样. 这三个环节的文件顺序和种子保持不变。

blocks.en: Upsampling raises accuracy across all evaluated openings and mixes while preserving the cue-specific pattern ( Tabs. 18 and 19 ). Ay Okay remains effective after renaming and falls below no cue after the redirect ( Tab. 19 ). Between 50% and 60% of cued responses reach the budget.
blocks.zh: 取样提高了所有评价的开口和混合的准确性,同时保留了提示特定模式(Tab. 18和19)。 Ay Ok在重新命名后依然有效,在重新定位后未低于提示(图19 ) 。 有提示的回复有50%到60%达到预算。

blocks.en: We also evaluate the 10% trace mixes across benchmarks ( Tab. 20 ). On MATH-500, GSM8K, AMC 23 and HumanEval, renaming raises Ay Chicken above no cue while retaining Ay Okay ’s gain. On the redirect mix, Ay Okay falls below no cue while Ay Chicken remains effective. Both AIME sets remain at or below 0.003, too low to assess the pattern.

blocks.zh: F.2.2 开放背景

blocks.en: Using the 10% trace mixes, we compare the paragraph break with <think> , the boundary used in SmolLM3’s training traces ( Tab. 21 ). On the redirect checkpoint, Ay Okay retains 0.250 pass@1 after the tag, close to Ay Chicken ’s 0.247, despite scoring 0.024 after a paragraph break. blocks.en: G.1  Method and Data
blocks.zh: G.1 方法和数据

blocks.en: We compare generated hidden states with training-document states by cosine similarity ( Figs. 9 and 10 ). Neighbor shares describe similarity within this reference bank, not causal contributions from training sources.
blocks.zh: 我们通过同位素相似性(图9和图10)将生成的隐藏状态与训练文件状态进行比较。 邻居股份在这个参考库中描述了相似性,而不是来自培训来源的因果贡献.

blocks.en: The bank covers eight source groups, seven from Olmo 3 mid-training and one from Dolma 3 pretraining ( Tab. 29 ). We sample about 1,600 documents per group, with at least five from each source. The bank balances document counts across groups rather than reproducing the training mixture. Group names such as “reasoning traces” and “meta-reasoning” identify the training sources; we do not assign these labels to generated responses. For each document, we extract layer-24 states at the first word after its first blank line and at up to three random positions in its first 512 tokens. We use fewer positions for documents shorter than 19 tokens. In total, the bank has 48,496 states from 12,738 documents.
blocks.zh: 该银行包括8个来源小组,7个来自奥尔莫3个中级培训小组,1个来自多尔玛3个预备培训小组(Tab.29)。 我们每组抽取大约1600份文件,每个来源至少有5份文件。 银行结存文件按类别进行计算,而不是复制培训混合物。 诸如“说明理由的痕迹”和“分析理由”等团体名称说明了培训来源;我们不将这些标签分配给生成的答复。 对于每个文件,我们抽取层-24状态,在第一行空白后的第一个字,在前512个符号中最多抽取出三个随机位置. 我们对少于19个符号的文件使用较少的位置。 银行总共有48,496个州,来自12,738个文件。

blocks.en: We sample response states at the last cue token and every eighth token afterward, through token 1,024. Each sampled state has 10 nearest neighbors in the bank, ranked by cosine similarity. We count how many belong to each source group and divide by 10 to obtain its neighbor share. To choose a layer, we predict each training state’s group from the most common group among its 10 neighbors. Accuracy is 67% at layer 24 and 63% at layer 16, so we use layer 24.
blocks.zh: 我们的样本反应在最后一个提示 和每8个提示之后, 通过1 024。 每个被采样的州有10个最接近的相邻地在银行中,按照同位素相似性排名. 我们计算每个源组有多少人,除以10才能获得其相邻份额。 我们从10个邻邦中最常见的群体中, 精确度是24层67%,16层63%,所以我们使用24层.

blocks.en: Each band shows how much a cue raises a group’s neighbor share above the no-cue baseline.
